heading: Composition
text:
### Composition [LDTL.2.2]

`dynamic_ttl` is orthogonal to every other capability:

| With `dynamic_ttl: true` and | Effect |
|---|---|
| `linear_scan: false` | Orthogonal. `linear_scan: false` restricts join and slot types; `dynamic_ttl` affects TTL expiry only. Both may be set. |

Composition with `realtime` is [LDTL.2.4].
